blocking_evidence: PROFIL/BIAS 2.0.8 official source marks its Windows 32-bit GCC configuration as under development; the available x86-64 configuration targets Linux ELF.
The PROFIL/BIAS x86-64 notes document a glibc/libm rounding-mode caveat; this machine is Windows UCRT64 and has no reviewed x86-64 directed-rounding configuration.
The pinned source documentation requests PROFIL/BIAS 2.0.2/2.0.4; the official retrievable source is 2.0.8. Compatibility is not established by syntax-only compilation.
The pinned VALENCIA 0.92_2e core lacks the 2013 piecewise derivative extension, so a successful legacy binary alone would not implement the selected paper method.
decision: No unsupported rounding backend or unreviewed architecture substitution was used. No full executable/link attempt was made. Syntax-only compilation against PROFIL/BIAS 2.0.8 source headers and FADBAD++ 1.4 passed.
